<b>Pilgrim Shawls</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
12 Pilgrim Shawls are required to complete the <i>[[Garb of the Pilgrims]]</i> [[wish]], given out by the [[Wishwalls|Wishwall]] at [[Bone Bottom]].

== How to Acquire ==
Shawls can be obtained from the corpses of slain pilgrims while <i>Garb of the Pilgrims</i> is active. They are most plentiful in [[Mosshome]] due to its large groups of pilgrim enemies:

Additionally, upon breaking bags containing Pilgrim corpses in [[Bilewater]], certain corpses will have collectable Shawls.

[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can carry up to 12 Pilgrim Shawls, after which they will no longer drop from defeated pilgrims or the corpses in Bilewater.

== Act 3 ==
All Pilgrim Shawls are removed from the inventory at the start of Act 3, as Bone Bottom has been destroyed.
